paper_title: Deepest sensitivity to wavelike dark photon dark matter with superconducting radio frequency cavities
notes: Proof-of-concept SRF cavity (nontunable, 1.3 GHz) dark photon haloscope. Excludes chi > 1.5e-16 at m_A' = 5.354 ueV (90% CL). Single narrow-band measurement; exclusion covers only a few peV around 5.354 ueV. Local DM density 0.45 GeV/cm^3, QDM~1e6 assumed.
